title: Settings
unsavedMessage: You have unsaved settings on this page. Save them?
unsavedHasErrors: There are validation errors. Go back to fix them, or discard all changes.

validate.header: {n} item(s) need to be fixed before saving
validate.invalidUrl: Must start with http:// or https://

smtp.title: SMTP Email
smtp.desc: Configure SMTP server for sending notification emails.
smtp.testHint: Send a test email using current (including unsaved) SMTP values.
smtp.testInvalid: Please enter a valid email address

branding.title: Appearance
branding.desc: Customize system name, branding, and page elements.
branding.tutorialUrl_tip: When set, a “Tutorials” entry appears in the user sidebar and opens this URL in a new tab. Leave empty to hide.
branding.allowRegistration_tip: When disabled, the sign-up button is hidden and only admins can create users.

support.title: Support Contact Info
support.desc: Configure contact info shown in the support modal. Empty fields are hidden.
support.footerNote_tip: Displayed below the contact list. Use for business hours or any custom note. Leave empty to hide.

payment.title: Payment

gateways.title: Payment Gateways
gateways.desc: Enable the payment methods you want to offer.

credentials.title: Gateway Credentials
credentials.desc: Configure the AppID and AppSecret. Changes take effect immediately.

urls.title: URL Configuration
urls.desc: Configure Referer and gateway endpoints. Notify/return URLs are auto-derived from the system Site URL (Appearance settings).

payment.referer_tip: Referer header sent with payment requests, usually your site root URL.
payment.gatewayEndpoints_tip: Comma-separated fallback endpoints tried in order.

quotas.title: Order Quotas & Policy
quotas.desc: Configure order timeout and per-user limits.

payment.payTimeout_tip: QR code validity is capped at 5 minutes. Keeping it at 5 is recommended.
payment.refundStuckHours_tip: Refunds pending longer than this become manual incidents.

defaults.title: Server Defaults
defaults.desc: Default resources and presets when creating new servers.

time.title: Timezone & Schedule Basis
time.desc: Set the timezone used by automation jobs; all schedule times are interpreted in this timezone.

delete.title: Auto Delete
delete.desc: Automatically delete servers after being suspended for a certain number of days

email.title: Expiration Email Reminder
email.desc: Automatically send reminder emails before server expiration
